items.title: Ethiopia's Tigray rebels declare 'full-blown war' as fighting spreads
items.description: The renewed clashes revive memories of a devastating 2020-2022 war that killed more than 600,000 people and displaced around one million.

items.title: Tigray rebels in 'full-blown' war with government
items.description: In tonight's edition, Tigrayans in northern Ethiopia start panic buying supplies in the rush to stock up amidst fears that months of tensions have finally tipped over into full-blown conflict. Also, power cuts return to Senegal. And Yemis Alade, the Nigerian superstar, is out with a new album and speaks to France 24.

items.title: Ethiopia's army says it has repelled attacks in first comment on fresh fighting
items.description: The military says its soldiers inflicted casualties as fears grow of a resumption of a full-blown civil war.

items.title: How renewed fighting in Tigray could spread across the Horn of Africa
items.description: The fresh hostilities in Ethiopia's Tigray region come after months of growing animosity between rebel forces and the federal government. Horn of Africa expert Martin Plaut warns of possible regional spillover.

items.title: Finance Ministry Unveils 2027 Budget Draft With Fresh Tax Hikes to Fund War Deficit
items.description: The proposed tax hikes come just weeks after the Kremlin insisted that officials were not discussing any further increases.

items.description: The second part of this investigation examines the global reach of Russia’s foreign recruitment campaign, focusing on South Asia, Latin America, Indonesia, and former Soviet states. Ukrainian officials and human rights organizations describe a recurring pattern: promises of civilian employment, fast-tracked citizenship…

items.title: Fears of return to war grow in Ethiopia's Tigray region
items.description: Fears are growing of a return to war in Ethiopia's Tigray region, just four years after a devastating conflict ended in a fragile peace deal.

items.title: Zelenskyy urges stronger pressure on Russia, warns war’s impact is spreading beyond Ukraine
items.description: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy on Wednesday called for intensified pressure on Russia to end its war against Ukraine, arguing that Moscow continues to incur massive losses while prolonging a conflict whose consequences are increasingly being felt far beyond the battlefield.

items.title: Trump, Zelenskyy Discuss Peace Negotiations, Potential Energy Cease-Fire
items.description: US President Donald Trump met with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy on the sidelines of the UN General Assembly on September 22. Trump said he believes that both Ukraine and Russia "want to see the war end," and raised the possibility of meeting with Russian President Vladimir Putin at the G20 summit in December…

items.title: At UN, Trump again threatens Iran, but suggests end of war is near
items.description: President Trump used his speech at the United Nations to say he believed the Iran war was coming to a resolution “one way or the other.”
